CustomField.description: Written by: the create leg, for a person known only from a MENTION. The name AS HEARD, rendered exactly as the designator was spoken, per the ASR-name law: what was said is the source form and we never correct a transcript's spelling into what we think was meant. "Fatima" stays "Fatima" even where the account carries a Fatema. THIS FIELD IS EVIDENCE, not sourced identity: it is words somebody said, and it is the half of this row that may be quoted. Compare AAO_Last_Name__c, which may not.
CustomField.label: Designator (as heard)
